Hi Samir / James —

Thanks again for the time earlier — really helpful to understand FinBank's latency & compliance requirements for the new fraud-detection feature. Quick recap and next steps: 

- Recap: you're evaluating inference platforms to reduce token costs and meet a 200ms 95th-ile latency target for short prompts (<=128 tokens).
- Key stakeholders: Samir (Product), Priya (Engineering), James (InfoSec / Procurement).
- Ask: schedule a focused 30-min product demo + technical deep dive with our solutions engineer to walk through latency profiling, KV caching, and rollout/SLAs.

Could you confirm availability for a 30-min slot next week? Here are a few options (all ET):

1) Tue, Mar 30 — 10:00–10:30am ET
2) Tue, Mar 30 — 2:00–1:30pm ET
3) Wed, Mar 31 — 11:00–11:30am ET

If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and we'll try to accommodate. We'll invite our Solutions Engineer (Dylan) and a short checklist for the call: expected attendees, any non-prod data sample for profiling (optional), and any procurement questions you want us to cover.

I've attached our short sales deck and a one-page mutual action plan to the thread for context.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
